reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V1 (declared best in REPORT 'Honest finish is to ship V1'): KS yaw-rate (v/L)*tan(delta) using canonical wheelbase per platform (Mach-E L=2.984, F-150 L=3.70), minus per-segment yaw-gyro bias computed as mean residual on straight samples (|delta|<0.01) for that segment (bias=0 if <=5 straight samples).
notes: V1 bias is deterministic from the data (no RNG); reproduces exactly across runs. Bias is fitted per-segment on the same Ford pool we score against (in-sample for the bias term, as agent acknowledged); per-platform wheelbase used (Mach-E 2.984 m, F-150 3.70 m). Baseline recomputation matches canonical V0 to within 1e-6.
